newsitem.title: USA: Infoseek to boost Web advertising efforts.
newsitem.headline: Infoseek to boost Web advertising efforts.

text.p: Infoseek Corp said it would increase its Internet advertising efforts through a new initiative that will allow the company to sell advertising on other company's Internet sites.

Infoseek, a leading provider of Internet navigation services, said it would establish relationships with popular Internet sites and use its sales and marketing expertise and systems to assist site owners in selling their advertising.

The company said its new Infoseek Network will provide Internet advertisers a simple, efficient way to purchase advertising that reaches target audiences. Infoseek Network will give advertisers the ability to place ads on some of the most frequently visited Internet sites.

Using Infoseek's ad delivery system, advertisers will be able to target their messages to the audiences they are trying to reach, either by targeting ads to sites with specific content, such as computers, business and sports, or by targeting specific audiences by geography or interests.
To become an Infoseek Network affiliate, sites must generate at least 300,000 viewer impressions per month. It also plans to extend the Infoseek Network to the Japanese market.
